parsed.notes: Lens B only; support and quote-fidelity merits were not evaluated.

reasons: Lake identity is verified for Oregon v. Bradshaw, U.S. Supreme Court, decided 1983-06-23, docket 81-1857.
Lake citations include official cite 462 U.S. 1039, the listed parallel cites, and 1983 U.S. LEXIS 82.
Lake treatment field_i_validity is good_law as of 2026-06-30, so no disclosed currency defect makes the authority non-live.
residual_risks: Treatment derivation flags audit_needed/proposed negative events, but the disclosed judgment field still marks the authority good_law and no edge has field_iii beyond mentioned.

reasons: Under Lens B, I do not make a support/holding-fidelity finding.
The treatment scope note says the two-step Edwards initiation/waiver framework is settled and good law, which defeats a currency/treatment attack on the holding as framed.
residual_risks: Support and quote-fidelity remain for Lens A.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Keep the plurality qualification attached to this holding wherever the rule is summarized.

reasons: Under Lens B, the home-role classification is not independently attacked for support.
No disclosed treatment field or progeny edge shows Oregon v. Bradshaw is no longer live authority for Miranda/Edwards waiver-and-invocation material.
residual_risks: Home-role taxonomy is outside the currency/treatment lens.

reasons: Lake identity lists court as U.S. Supreme Court and court_level as scotus.
A SCOTUS source supports the weight label Binding — SCOTUS; the plurality nature affects scope, not the source-court weight.

Content treatment fields match the lake treatment fields: field_i_validity good_law, as_of_content 1983-06-23, as_of_treatment 2026-06-30, composite_basis migration-seed, composite_basis_ref Oregon v. Bradshaw, varies_by_point false, and the same plurality/scope note.
All disclosed treatment edges are proposed and have field_iii marked mentioned; no disclosed edge itself says Bradshaw was overruled, abrogated, superseded, or limited.
residual_risks: The treatment derivation reports cap_hit and audit_needed for negative/top-cited lanes, so future audit could refine the judgment; on the disclosed record, the final treatment judgment remains good_law.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Preserve the existing scope note so readers see that the good-law status is for the two-step framework stated in a plurality opinion.
